skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate and edit images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full image-model catalog: FLUX 2 (Klein 9B/4B, Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo, Max), Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, Wan 2-7. Covers both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image / edit (i2i) endpoints — the skill picks the right model for the user's actual intent (typography precision, photoreal portraits, sub-second iteration, multi-reference brand styling, open-weights workflow) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "make an image of …", "image to image", "i2i", or any explicit ask to create or restyle an image.
skill.summary: Route text-to-image and image-editing requests across RunComfy models with practical prompts and CLI commands.
skill.author: genmedia-labs

security_audit.summary: All 199 static matches are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, placeholder URLs, standard configuration paths, or model-selection prose. The contextual review found expected third-party data transmission and unpinned package setup commands, with no prompt injection or covert behavior.

remediation.issue: Prompts and reference assets are transmitted to RunComfy.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step before sending sensitive content and link to the service retention and privacy terms.

remediation.issue: Package installation examples do not pin immutable versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package versions and hashes in npm and npx examples, then document a controlled update process.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Choosing an image model and its parameters can slow creative work. This skill routes requests to suitable RunComfy models and provides focused prompts and commands.
actual_capabilities: Routes text-to-image requests across FLUX, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Qwen, Wan, and Dreamina models.
Routes image edits to Nano Banana, GPT Image, FLUX Kontext, Seedream, Qwen, Dreamina, or Wan endpoints.
Provides documented RunComfy CLI commands for common generation and editing tasks.
Recommends model-specific prompt structure, dimensions, resolution, steps, seeds, and reference-image settings.
Supports workflows for typography, portraits, product images, concept art, batches, and multilingual creatives.
Explains CLI authentication, output directories, exit codes, and troubleshooting references.
limitations: Requires the external RunComfy CLI, an account, network access, and any applicable service credits.
Model availability, pricing, schemas, and output quality can change outside this skill.
Reference assets and prompts are processed by a third-party service.
Mask-driven inpainting and advanced batch editing require a separate image-editing skill.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate posters and advertisements with precise layout, quoted headlines, and multilingual text guidance.

use_cases.title: Develop Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Produce fast image batches, compare directions, and refine selected concepts at higher resolution.

use_cases.title: Automate Creative Production
use_cases.description: Select image endpoints and prepare repeatable RunComfy commands for scripted generation workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [style], [lighting], and a [aspect ratio] composition. Save the result in [output folder].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one image from a clear description.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Typography Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [orientation] poster with the exact headline "[text]" in [script and type style]. Use [palette], [subject], and [layout].
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs accurate visible text and controlled layout.

prompt_templates.title: Edit with Identity Preservation
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [reference image URL]. Preserve [identity, pose, clothing, and layout]. Change only [specific element] to [desired result].
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator needs a focused image edit without unrelated changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Stage Image Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RunComfy workflow for [goal]. Compare suitable models by quality, speed, cost, typography, and reference support. Generate drafts, select a seed, then refine.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs model selection and repeatable iteration.

output_examples.input: Create a landscape launch poster with the exact headline "AURORA Spring 2026".
output_examples.output: Selected GPT Image 2 for precise typography. Produced a landscape poster with the requested headline, centered composition, and saved output location.

output_examples.input: Create four quick square concepts for a ceramic mug in warm morning light.
output_examples.output: Selected Nano Banana 2 for rapid iteration. Produced four low-resolution square concepts with a reusable seed and consistent product framing.

output_examples.input: Keep the person unchanged but replace the background with a rainy city street.
output_examples.output: Selected Nano Banana 2 Edit for identity preservation. Produced an edited image that retains the subject while changing the background.

best_practices: State the subject first, then describe the scene, composition, lighting, and style.
Use low-resolution batches for exploration, then increase quality only for selected results.
Provide only approved reference URLs and request web grounding explicitly when it is necessary.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential prompts, personal images, or private asset URLs without approval.
Do not request arbitrary dimensions from models that support only fixed size options.
Do not combine many unrelated edits in one instruction when identity preservation matters.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI, authenticate with RunComfy, and ensure network access and sufficient service credits.

faq.question: Which model does the skill choose by default?
faq.answer: It recommends FLUX 2 Klein 9B for general text-to-image work and Nano Banana 2 Edit for general image editing.

faq.question: Can it generate text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends GPT Image 2 and asks you to quote exact text while naming the script and layout.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an approved HTTPS reference and describe what must remain unchanged before stating the requested edit.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy command downloads completed files into the output directory selected for the task.

faq.question: Does this skill process data locally?
faq.answer: No. The CLI sends inputs to RunComfy infrastructure and downloads generated results after remote processing.
